conventions.keys: Species/moves/abilities/items keyed by PokéRogue enum member names (SpeciesId/MoveId/AbilityId/...).
conventions.enumArgs: Numeric enum members -> member name; string enums (e.g. SpeciesFormKey) -> their string value. argKinds[i] tells what each arg was (enum:<Name>, number, string, boolean, array, object, const:<NAME>, raw).
conventions.raw: Anything not statically evaluable (lambdas, new expressions, conditions, i18n calls) is kept as comment-free single-line source text.
conventions.nulls: power/accuracy/chance -1 in PokéRogue -> null (accuracy null = never misses). abilities.a2 null = PokéRogue reuses a1 for that slot; hidden null = none.
conventions.learnsets: SPECIES = default form (levelMoves + formLevelMoves[forms[0].formKey]); 'SPECIES:formKey' = full list for that form. Level 0 = EVOLVE_MOVE, -1 = RELEARN_MOVE.
conventions.tms: Effective TM learners like PokéRogue getTms(): own tms + formTms + prevolution chain. 'SPECIES:formKey' listed only when that non-default form learns it but the default form does not.
conventions.formChanges: synthesized:true entries are the reverse item changes PokéRogue adds at runtime (initReverseFormChanges).
conventions.unused: moves/abilities with unused:true sit inside PokéRogue's /* Unused */ blocks (Z-moves, Max moves, ...). gmax-moves.json are commented out entirely in PokéRogue (no MoveId).
